charged_scalar_aliases.charged_scalar_eta05: sum over bins of pth#charged_eta05#<field> (hydro-event aggregated in v3)
charged_scalar_aliases.charged_scalar_eta10: sum over bins of pth#charged_eta10#<field> (hydro-event aggregated in v3)

et_conventions.mass_source: PDG pole mass table (not OSCAR line mass)

global_et_definition.explicit_hadronic_exceptions: 9000221 is counted as hadronic-visible global ET if present, but is not promoted to a core analysis species or restored to the pole-mass table.
global_et_definition.hadronic: hadronic-component ET mask: known hadronic species, EXCLUDING the EM-component set. This is an experimental ET-component bookkeeping split (ALICE category A+C+D vs B), NOT a quark-content statement -- pi0/eta/omega are mesons but assigned to the EM component.
global_et_definition.neutral_kaon_weight: FULL weight in global ET (K0S 0.5 weight is yield-only)
global_et_definition.oscar_line_mass: IGNORED for ET; pole mass from the PDG table is used instead, so off-shell resonances use their species pole mass.
global_et_definition.total_visible: all final particles except neutrinos; includes the EM-component set {gamma, e+-, pi0, eta, omega} and all hadronic species
global_et_definition.unknown_pdg_policy: a visible PDG that is neither EM nor a known hadronic species aborts caching by default (would be dropped from hadronic ET).

k0s_convention: abs(pdg)==311; species yield/ET weight 0.5; flow unweighted pooled; M_K0S_flow ~= 2*N_K0S_yield; global ET uses FULL weight
